method: Production cardAI + actCardsMutable; paired fixed A/B random streams, swapped first player. Each independent pair also varies equal ability-gated fixed person profiles. CI is paired normal 95%; draws score 0.5. Controller is heuristic, not a human or optimal policy.

acceptance.note: Point-estimate gate only; inspect per-case confidence intervals. Base matrix does not establish configured decks/weapons/secrets/landmarks coverage.

telemetry.notes: Counts aggregate by initiative position and own turn. End-state totals include completed turns only; divide by completed. Action totals include terminal partial turns; divide by reached. Traces are reproducible examples of first-player losses, not causal estimates.
